name: horizontal.
long_description:
Every factory will be run by AI agents. Horizontal is building them.

Today, the work that keeps production moving is scattered across people, teams, and disconnected software. When plans change, materials run short, or quality issues appear, factory teams piece together the context and coordinate the response by hand.

Horizontal's AI agents take on that operational work inside the systems factories already use. They replan production around a disruption, investigate quality issues and coordinate order releases across teams and tools. Manufacturers start with one process and add agents over time, building toward a system that coordinates the factory end to end.

Factories are demanding environments for AI: every plant has its own systems and procedures, and every action must work in the context of real production. Our team combines mechanical engineering and shop-floor experience with a track record of building and deploying agentic AI in global industrial companies.

Horizontal connects the people, software and machines that run production.
one_liner: AI agents that run factory operations end-to-end.

launches.title: Horizontal: AI agents that run factory operations end-to-end
launches.tagline: Taking over the daily work that keeps a plant running.
launches.body:
Horizontal (YC F26) is building autonomous factory operations, one agent at a time.

Robots build the product, but people still run the factory. Production & material planners, logistics and quality teams spend their days keeping the plant in sync, by hand, across emails, spreadsheets and a dozen disconnected systems.

Horizontal's agents do that work themselves, across the whole operation. They replan production when an order changes, check material availability, investigate quality issues, release finished batches and keep shipments on time. The agents work directly in the systems the factory already uses and get better with every task. Enterprise manufacturers start with one process and add agents over time, until the whole factory runs end to end.

<https://youtu.be/h9Oa3QLvsYs>

The founders Niklas Marxer and Jakob Hermeler are mechanical engineers who met doing robotics research at Stanford. Together they have built and deployed agentic AI in demanding environments at global industrial companies, where reliability and auditability are non-negotiable.
